asset_description: A green cartoon parrot with a blazing red crest storms into a wood-panelled living room, wings spread and beak open in fury. A large blue parrot gets off the sofa and folds a wing around it. The red crest sinks and drains from fire-red to pale yellow to soft green, and the angry bird stops shouting, leans into the hug and closes its eyes.

asset_description: On the lawn of a grand country estate on a grey day, a smiling grey-bearded older man in a red velvet robe with a white ermine cape and a jewelled gold crown rides a muddy quad bike towards the camera, first holding his crown with one hand and then gripping the handlebars. He laughs as the quad splashes through a big muddy puddle, and mud and water spray from the wheels. Behind him stand large old trees and a pale stone mansion with tall columns.
title: king_7071

asset_description: A dark wooden house stands in deep snow on a clear winter day, with icicles hanging from the roof. A young woman in a red knitted hat, navy jacket and black trousers digs with a snow shovel, cutting a narrow path through snow as high as her waist along the house. A husky runs along the cleared path behind her and past her. She throws a shovel of snow high over the wall. Inside, an older man and woman watch through the big glass window.
title: way_8039

asset_description: A black-and-white ink illustration in the style of an old engraving. A large striped hot-air balloon floats among a few sketched clouds. A small man in a suit and tie hangs below it, holding the ropes with one raised hand while his legs dangle in the air. The balloon drifts gently up and to the side, and the man sways on the ropes. This is a balloon that is filled with hot air and can carry a person high into the sky.
title: balloon_8055

asset_description: A black line drawing on white with orange details. A bearded man in a hat and an orange shirt sits with his legs crossed on a long seat in a park and reads a book. A black-and-white dog with an orange collar sits on the ground beside him and looks up at him. Leaves fall slowly from two round trees, and the dog moves its head and tail a little. The long seat he is sitting on is a bench, and there is still room on it for more than one person.
